description: Source code implementing parsing, forging, comparison, and visiting functions for LLDP TLV (Type-Length-Value) structures used in IEEE 1905.1/1a protocol stack. The code handles TLV types such as End of LLDP PDU, Chassis ID, Port ID, and Time to Live, following IEEE standards.

methods.name: uint8_t * parse_lldp_TLV_from_packet(uint8_t * packet_stream)
methods.description: Parses a byte stream containing LLDP TLV data, returning a structure representing the TLV based on its type.

methods.name: uint8_t * forge_lldp_TLV_from_structure(uint8_t * memory_structure,uint16_t * len)
methods.description: Creates a byte stream from a TLV structure suitable for transmission, based on the TLV type and contents.

methods.name: void free_lldp_TLV_structure(uint8_t * memory_structure)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for TLV structures.

methods.name: uint8_t compare_lldp_TLV_structures(uint8_t * memory_structure_1,uint8_t * memory_structure_2)
methods.description: Compares two TLV structures for equality.

methods.name: void visit_lldp_TLV_structure(uint8_t * memory_structure,void (* callback)(void (* write_function)(const char * fmt,...),const char * prefix,size_t size,const char * name,const char * fmt,void * p),void (* write_function)(const char * fmt,...),const char * prefix)
methods.description: Visits the fields of a TLV structure and applies a callback function for each.

methods.name: char * convert_lldp_TLV_type_to_string(uint8_t tlv_type)
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a given TLV type.

ctags.name: visit_lldp_TLV_structure
